A_cleanup_ancestry.summary: Current-ppid BFS cannot reach a setsid()/detached:true grandchild because macOS rewrites ppid to 1 on reparenting. Apple kqueue(2) documents EVFILT_PROC separately from current ppid; there is no 'original_ppid' in the user-visible kinfo_proc.

B_kqueue_lineage.summary: kqueue EVFILT_PROC NOTE_FORK attaches successfully (cross-process, same-process), fires on subsequent forks, but kevent.data carries NO child PID (must reconcile via sysctl KERN_PROC). The dominant defect is the FORK-BEFORE-ATTACH race: the fixture's first fork (e.g. shell->node) happens before the helper can attach kqueue, so the intermediate child is never observed. The production sequence (spawn-then-attach) loses this race deterministically across 5/5 immediate-fork iterations.
B_kqueue_lineage.RACE_FINDING: immediate-fork fixture always beats the probe attach

C_endpoint_security_descendants.summary: Three independent blockers: (1) EndpointSecurity.framework headers absent from the macOS 14.0 CommandLineTools SDK; (2) runtime framework absent from /System/Library/Frameworks, /System/Library/PrivateFrameworks, and the Cryptex root; (3) helper binary is adhoc-signed without a Developer Team, so com.apple.developer.endpoint-security.client cannot be granted. C_RUNTIME_ELIGIBILITY = UNAVAILABLE is a legitimate discriminator result, not a configuration defect.

selection.reason: Per spec §9: A is refuted on correctness (cannot reach reparented grandchild); B is refuted on production feasibility (FORK-BEFORE-ATTACH race loses 5/5 iterations); C is unavailable on this substrate (framework absent + entitlement impossible). Per spec §9 last paragraph: if B fails and C is unavailable, close with CAPTURED_ARCHITECTURAL_LIMIT and NO_SAFE_GENERAL_DESCENDANT_CONTAINMENT_AVAILABLE.

production_code_delta_detail: No production-side helper.c, protocol.ts, command-job-manager.ts, or other runtime code was modified. Only diagnostic probe binaries were added under tools/macos-host-helper/native/containment-probe/; these are intentionally outside the production helper protocol and do not modify the wire format or any consumer-facing surface.
successor_mandate: Decide whether to (a) prohibit detached process creation in ClineMM-owned commands at the policy layer, (b) accept the gap and document ESCAPED_DESCENDANTS as a known unsupported boundary, or (c) pursue Endpoint Security descendants under a separately-authorized architecture track (Developer ID signing + ES entitlement). This ACT does NOT make that decision.
